note: USACE Perry Lake's largest campground, on the east side off Slough Creek Road (7 mi north of Perry via Ferguson Road): four loops strung along one park road - Burr Oak and Locust to the north, the Whippoorwill peninsula and the South peninsula. About a third of the electric sites have no water hookup. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read today: 170 campsites (126 electric, 83 with water; 44 non-electric) + 3 group camps, 50 A at 28 sites, max 72 ft, 10 pull-throughs, $20-32 for 2026-28 (stored $16-26 stale), open Apr 15-Oct 15, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14 in 30 days. Lakefront kept (Whippoorwill south bank). No split.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept, per loop: WHIPPOORWILL south-bank sites W019-W024 sit on the lake side of their road with open grass and riprap 25-40 m to the cove, no road or day use between (on-water); W017/W018 face the inner cove across a brushy grass slope. The Whippoorwill east-shore sites (W027-W036) are in trees 30-60 m back with a dense wooded fringe - lakeview. SOUTH loop S017-S021 at the point have a second bank road between them and the water (road-blocked, lakeview), S038-S044 sit behind brush and trees. BURR OAK and LOCUST are on wooded fingers at the north end (not examined closely). No campsite carries a rec.gov 'Proximity to Water' tag.

SPLIT: not a candidate. Per-area data: Burr Oak 21 sites (6 E30/W, 15 non-electric, 46-60 ft, centroid 39.14037,-95.42573); Locust 17 (14 E30/W, 3 non-electric, 30-70 ft, 1 pull-through, centroid 39.13833,-95.42585); Whippoorwill 78 (72 electric incl. 14 at 50 A, 29 with water, 35-72 ft, 9 pull-through, centroid 39.13425,-95.42394); South 54 (34 electric incl. 14 at 50 A, all with water, 20 non-electric, 32-62 ft, centroid 39.13057,-95.42671). Nearest sites between neighbouring loops: Burr Oak-Locust 105 m, Locust-Whippoorwill 231 m, Whippoorwill-South 181 m (Burr Oak to South 884 m end to end). All four branch off the one park road behind the one gate - no separate entrance.
